messages:
Aisha (partnerships): Quick sync: VaultWave (vendor) signed NDA and wants joint engineering for their HSM-backed gateway + SCIM/SAML provisioning. Aim: marketplace listing + joint announcement in ~5-6 weeks. Who can pick up the integration tech owner?
Diego (security): I'll own security review. Need to validate HSM attestation, KMIP vs provider API parity, and key wrap semantics. Also require a crypto policy doc from VaultWave.
Mina (eng): I'll lead the engineering work. Questions: do they support direct key import, or only envelope encryption via proxy? Need staging endpoints and a SCIM test tenant.
Aisha (partnerships): They support envelope flow and optional key import for enterprise plans. They shared an initial integration PDF (link posted in the vendor portal).
Olga (product): Scope: we need config knobs for Private/Dedicated customers to choose VaultWave as an external KMS; Hosted should be opt-out and disabled by default. Also listing requirements for AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace.
Priya (legal): NDA is okay. We'll need a data flow appendix confirming no plaintext material is persisted on their side and a retention policy. Also add an embargo clause for the announcement; marketing needs 7 business days pre-review.
Jacob (sales): Recommend gating early access to 3 enterprise beta customers (NA/EMEA/APAC) — will coordinate. Getting customer references will help the marketplace listing.
Mina (eng): Draft tech checklist:
```
- Provisioning: SCIM group -> Redwood roles mapping; verify group lifecycle events
- SSO: SAML metadata exchange + assertion signing tests
- KMS: envelope encrypt/decrypt, key import (if available), rotation tests
- Network: private endpoint + TLS client cert handshake
- Observability: ensure audit events include envelope key_id + requestor
- Failover: procedure to fallback to Redwood-managed KMS
```
Diego (security): Add: HSM attestation verification (quote), allowed ciphers list, automated CI tests for rotate/unseal, and threat model signoff. Also require proof they zeroize keys after import if customer requests.
ci-bot: Created calendar event: vaultwave-integration-sync @ 2027-03-02 09:00 PT; invites sent.
Mina (eng): For SCIM example they gave: `{
  "userName": "dev@example.com",
  "externalId": "12345",
  "groups": ["infra", "admin"]
}` — we'll confirm attribute mappings.
Olga (product): Marketplace checklist: 1) Billing integration for marketplace metering 2) Support contacts + escalation path 3) SLA matrix 4) Security attestation copy. Engineering: can you draft a short on-call runbook for when the external KMS misbehaves?
Diego (security): Runbook items: revoke provider access, rotate to backup key, audit trail extraction steps, and how to validate envelope signatures.
Priya (legal): Also require mutual logo/brand usage guidelines before publishing. I will pre-clear announcement language conditioned on final security attestation.
Aisha (partnerships): Action items + owners:
- Ask VaultWave for retention/attestation + staging tenant (Aisha) 024h
- Full tech spec + SCIM/SAML test plan (Mina)  5 business days
- Security checklist & HSM attestation criteria (Diego)  5 business days
- Legal appendix & branding approval (Priya)  7 business days
- Early access customer list (Jacob)  4 business days
- Marketplace listing draft (Olga)  12 business days
Mina (eng): Note: keep feature behind feature-flag and disabled for hosted customers by default. We'll require the security checklist to be completed before enabling for any customer.
Jacob (sales): Once we have a staging integration I'll coordinate two joint customer calls (one EMEA, one NA).
Aisha (partnerships): I'll update the thread after the vendor sync and attach their attestation docs when received. Please react with any blockers. :+1:
